paragraphs.text: South Pontotoc’s girls beat Shannon 63–31 on Monday to move to 7–0. North Pontotoc’s boys fell 62–57 at Saltillo. The Vikings are 6–3.

The 32-point win over Shannon continued a run that stretches back to the Cougars’ season opener against Byhalia. South Pontotoc has won all seven games by at least 20 points. Its closest game so far was Thursday’s 62–42 win over Lafayette.

North Pontotoc has lost its last two games by a combined seven points. Biggersville won by two in Ecru on Friday before Saltillo won by five on Monday. The Vikings had won their previous two road games, at Alcorn Central and Water Valley.
South Pontotoc’s girls are scheduled to play Mooreville at 4:30 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24. North Pontotoc’s boys next play at Hamilton at 7:30 p.m. Monday, Nov. 30.
